scenarios.setting: You are touring an apartment and being pushed to transfer a deposit.
scenarios.jab: Send the deposit now and we'll sort the paperwork later.

replies.line: I'll review the lease and payment terms before sending a deposit.
replies.why: It puts verification ahead of the pressured payment.
replies.delivery: Use a level tone on “before”; do not soften the boundary into a tentative question.

replies.why: It makes the order of decisions clear without promising payment.
replies.delivery: Say “Paperwork first” clearly, then stop instead of adding a defense. Do not soften the boundary into a tentative question.

replies.line: Please send the documents and payment instructions so I can review everything together.
replies.why: It requests the information required for a considered decision.
replies.delivery: Keep “Please send the documents and payment instructions so” warm and unhurried; finish the request clearly. Do not soften the boundary into a tentative question.

replies.why: A brief joke makes the sequence memorable without alleging fraud.
replies.delivery: Keep “My money travels with paperwork” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. Do not soften the boundary into a tentative question.

followUp.jab: That's not how we usually do it.
followUp.line: I understand; I won't send money before reviewing the terms.
followUp.why: It maintains your boundary without debating their usual practice.
followUp.delivery: Use a level tone on “before”; do not soften the boundary into a tentative question.
